title: The 11 Best Blenders Under $100
metaDescription: Our 11 picks for blenders under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at blenders under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Ninja Professional Plus Blender BN701 72-oz
products.blurb: Key specs: 1,000W motor, 72-oz Tritan container, Total Crushing stacked blade assembly.
strengths: Stacked blade design contacts ingredients at multiple heights, producing smooth frozen-fruit results in 30 to 45 seconds
72-oz container batches 4 to 6 servings per blend
Certified for crushing ice cubes without added liquid
Auto-iQ programs remove manual timing for consistent daily results
limitations: Leaves detectable chunks on raw kale stems or fully frozen mango where a Vitamix does not
No variable speed dial, 3 fixed speeds plus pulse
No tamper included for dense blends

products.name: NutriBullet Pro 900 Personal Blender
products.blurb: Key specs: 900W motor, 32-oz colossal cup, Cyclonic extractor blade.
strengths: 900W handles fully frozen fruit and leafy greens without stalling, unlike the 600W NutriBullet
32-oz cup is the ideal single-serve size for daily smoothie volumes
Extractor blade pulls seeds and stems into the cutting zone more completely than a flat blade
Replacement gaskets and blades are cheap and widely stocked
limitations: No speed control, single-speed motor like other NutriBullet models
Not rated for crushing dry ice cubes on their own
Louder than the smaller 600W model at comparable run time
features: Blends and drinks from same cup

products.name: Oster Pro 1200 Blender 6-Cup
products.blurb: Key specs: 1,200W motor, 6-cup (48-oz) glass jar, 7-speed dial plus pulse.
strengths: 1,200W handles daily frozen fruit and occasional ice without straining
Glass jar resists scratching and clouding better than plastic over years of use
7-speed dial gives finer control than typical budget blenders' 2 to 3 speeds
limitations: Motor strains on fully frozen, low-liquid blends more than the Ninja
Glass jar is heavier and chip-prone compared to Tritan plastic
1-year warranty and a shorter documented lifespan than premium options

products.name: NutriBullet 600W Compact Personal Blender
products.blurb: Key specs: 600W motor, 24-oz blending cup, Cyclonic extractor blade.
strengths: Blends and drinks from the same 24-oz cup, cutting cleanup to a rinse
Compact enough to travel or store in small kitchens
limitations: 600W bogs down on fully frozen fruit straight from the freezer
Not rated for crushing dry ice cubes
No speed control, one button, one speed
features: Blends and drinks from same cup

products.name: Ninja BL770 Mega Kitchen System 72-oz
products.blurb: Key specs: 1,500W motor, 72-oz pitcher plus 16-oz personal cup, Total Crushing stacked blade system.
strengths: 1,500W and a 72-oz pitcher batch enough for a family in one blend
Comes with a personal cup, covering both batch and single-serve use without a second appliance
limitations: Larger footprint takes up more counter and cabinet space than a standard pitcher blender
1-year warranty despite the higher price within this list
More parts (pitcher, cup, multiple blade assemblies) to store and clean

products.name: Ninja SS201 Foodi Power Nutri 72-oz Blender
products.blurb: Key specs: 1,400W motor, 72-oz pitcher, Nutri Ninja cups included.
strengths: 1,400W handles frozen fruit and ice without straining
Combo cup system runs both pitcher and personal-cup blends off one motor base
Auto-iQ smoothie preset produces consistent daily results without manual timing
72-oz pitcher on the same base as the included single-serve cups
limitations: More parts (pitcher, cups, blade assemblies) to store than a single-format blender
Motor overheats on sustained heavy loads like nut butter
features: Auto-iQ Smoothie and Frozen Drink presets
Blade-lock cup adapter for single-serve blending

products.name: KitchenAid KSB4027CU K400 Blender 56-oz
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.5-peak HP motor, 56-oz BPA-free pitcher, 5 pre-programmed settings including Smoothie and Ice Crush.
strengths: Intelli-Speed control senses blend thickness and adjusts motor speed automatically
56-oz pitcher covers 2 to 4 smoothie servings per blend
5 preset programs cover most household tasks without manual dialing
limitations: 1.5-peak HP trails the top Ninja models on dense or fibrous blends
features: 5 pre-programmed settings including Smoothie and Ice Crush
Intelli-Speed motor control adjusts speed during blend

products.name: Hamilton Beach 58148A Power Elite Blender 40-oz
products.blurb: Key specs: 700-peak-watt motor, 40-oz glass jar, 3 pre-programmed settings (smoothie, milkshake, ice crush).
strengths: Wave-Action blade system continuously forces mixture back into the blades, a real edge over static-blade budget blenders
40-oz glass jar covers 2 to 3 servings per blend
3 preset programs simplify daily use
limitations: 700 peak watts is the lowest-power countertop blender in this roundup, struggles with fully frozen fruit
Motor and gasket durability trail Ninja and Oster in daily heavy use
1-year warranty and a shorter expected lifespan (1 to 2 years of daily use)

products.name: Cuisinart CPB-300 SmartPower Compact Blender 32-oz
products.blurb: Key specs: 500W motor, 32-oz BPA-free jar, 14-speed electronic touchpad.
strengths: 14-speed touchpad gives more granular control than most blenders at this price
32-oz jar and compact base suit smaller kitchens and 1 to 2-serving blends
Ice-crush function handles occasional frozen drinks adequately
Recognizable build quality from an established countertop appliance brand
limitations: 500W is on the low end for fully frozen fruit or dense smoothies
32-oz capacity limits it to single or double servings

products.name: Vitamix Immersion Blender 5-Speed Hand Blender
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 variable speeds, Stainless-steel blending shaft, Blends directly in the pot or pitcher.
strengths: Blends hot soup directly in the pot, eliminating the hot-liquid transfer risk of a countertop blender
5 variable speeds give control from gentle mixing to full puree
Detachable stainless shaft cleans in seconds and stores compactly
Carries the Vitamix build-quality reputation at a fraction of a full-size Vitamix's price
limitations: Cannot batch smoothies the way a pitcher or personal-cup blender does
Less effective on fully frozen fruit or ice than a full-power countertop blender
Requires holding and moving the wand by hand throughout the blend
features: Blends directly in the pot or pitcher

products.name: Ninja UltraCrush Professional Blender (BP201)
strengths: 1000W crushes ice well
Large 72 oz pitcher
Simple three-speed controls
Affordable full-size blender
limitations: Loud
Stacked blades are sharp and awkward to clean
Not for very smooth nut butters

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
